stories.title: Spontaneous magnons synchronize with external signals at room temperature
stories.desc: Signals ride on waves of one kind or another: light, sound, radio. But new carriers are needed to relay information in next-generation devices. Disturbances or waves in magnetic materials called magnons could be an efficient option—if scientists can tame them.
